threshold.source: https://docs.drand.love/blog/2023/10/16/quicknet-is-live/ - 'current threshold is 12 out of 22 nodes, it should increase as the League of Entropy onboards new members'. The same post says the League runs 'currently 23 nodes'.
threshold.whyNotLive: No public drand endpoint serves the group file. /info and /v2/chains/<hash>/info (checked 2026-09-26) carry the key, period, genesis and groupHash but not t or n; /<hash>/group returns 403; the v2 router lists only health, info and rounds. `drand show group` reads a LOCAL node's group file, so it needs an operator. The figure is the network's own statement at launch and may have changed at a later resharing, which keeps the public key and chain hash.

margins.rule: tlockRound = roundAt(T + M), T = timestamp(commitEnd + 1). docs/design/v2.md section 4.3.
margins.note: roundAt(T + M) is published at or before T + M, up to period - 1 = 2 s earlier (timestamps are whole seconds), so the effective margin is between M - 2 and M seconds.

verified.how: GET <mirror>/<chainHash>/info on all four mirrors returned identical public_key, period, genesis_time, hash, groupHash, schemeID and beaconID. The chain hash is sha256(uint32_be(period) || int64_be(genesisTime) || publicKey || groupHash || beaconID); test/js/tlock.test.js recomputes it from the fields above.
verified.roundCheck: GET https://api.drand.sh/<chainHash>/public/latest returned round 32520078 at wall clock 1790363598; floor((1790363598 - 1692803367) / 3) + 1 = 32520078.
verified.ibe: The IBE tags (H1 = RFC 9380 G1 DST 'BLS_SIG_BLS12381G1_XMD:SHA-256_SSWU_RO_NUL_', H2/H3/H4 = sha256 prefixes 'IBE-H2'/'IBE-H3'/'IBE-H4') are proved by the interop vectors in test/js/vectors/tlock-js.json against tlock-js 0.9.0.
